name: List skills
description: Lists configured Knowledge Retention skills with bounded metadata. Use query or slug to narrow the catalog; instructions and file contents are returned by detail actions. Requires trustedSkillIds connection configuration.

inputFields.label: Result limit
inputFields.description: Optional number of skills to return, from 1 to 250. Defaults to 50 when omitted.

inputFields.label: Search query
inputFields.description: Optional text used by Langdock to search skill names and descriptions. Omit it to list the first page.

inputFields.label: Skill slug
inputFields.description: Optional exact lowercase skill slug filter, containing only letters, numbers, and dashes.

inputFields.label: Page cursor
inputFields.description: Optional UUID cursor returned by the previous skill catalog response. Omit it for the first page.
